name: Familiarity Bond
body:
Your form is that of a bonded weapon.

Prerequisite(s): Arma, arcane bond with a bonded weapon that matches the arma’s weapon form or bladebound magus with a black blade matching his weapon form.

Benefit(s): An arma may spend a swift action to treat its bonded weapon or black blade as its weapon form for one turn. This grants all the enhancement bonuses, weapon special abilities, and intelligent item abilities of the arma’s weapon form. The weapon is considered to have the same stats as the arma’s weapon form to determine the effects of their intelligent item abilities.
